queries: hallucination leaderboard February 2025 lowest hallucination rate

sources_considered.why: A public leaderboard that measures how often models hallucinate when summarizing documents. The Internet Archive copy last updated on 28 February 2025 was used.

evidence_items.locator: leaderboard table, top row, page last updated 28 February 2025

receipt.public_excerpt: Last updated on February 28th, 2025 Model Hallucination Rate Factual Consistency Rate Answer Rate Average Summary Length (Words) Google Gemini-2.0-Flash-001 0.7 %

evidence_items.explanation: Vectara's leaderboard measures how often models introduce hallucinations when summarizing a document, using its own evaluation model. In the update of 28 February 2025, the best-scoring model, Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash, hallucinated in 0.7% of summaries, and every listed model scored above zero.

unresolved_gaps: The measurement covers summarization of given documents, not every kind of chatbot use.
